notes.title: Early Access Patch Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

A couple of months have passed since our last update, and we figured it was time to give you guys another heads up regarding the game. This update is going to be brief, but quite significant, so let's get to it!

Progress Since Last Update

Before we get to the big news, let's talk about the progress in general. Yes, the game is still going strong: Right now it is also undergoing a very important overhaul to gameplay systems. We will come back between mid to late november to address this with actual gameplay footage so you guys can have the entire picture, but let's just say it's quite exciting! 

We also mentioned on the last update that the majority of voice overs have been finalized and recorded. Currently, we are in the middle of separation for implementation. There are a few things that are still missing, so we will wait before we confirm wether or not voice acting will appear on next patch, but it is very likely! We are super happy with the performances, courtesy of the talent we worked with!

And before we get to the big news, let's at least share with you guys the looks of all 16 Gastova costumes, which are finalized and being implemented in game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36818789/ecf3454c4f1a171ca4317445b22d4e463657ba2a.gif

These outfits will have several different gameplay effects, so it's not just looks! Again, we'll have more news regarding that next update~

Important Warnings
We are sad to inform that there is a possibility that saves may once more be compromised. We don't know the extent of that yet, as we have to conduct more internal tests. We are studying ways to compensate players for the inconvenience in the event that saves are causing issues. For the time being, we still believe them to be compatible, but there is a chance that it might change in the next couple of months. We will come with more information about this next month. For now, please continue enjoying the game, and back up your saves!

Another thing that needs to be addressed is controls, more specifically, keyboard editing. It has come to our attention that the feature has been causing several issues and locking players out of the game, unable to restore things to the way it once was. So for the time being, we will backtrack and remove the access to the feature. We truly apologize for the inconvenience.

As a form to compensate, we are looking into implementing fixed control schemes for gamepads and keyboards both. We will launch a controls survey somewhere next week to ask for your input, in the discussion.

Release Date of Endgame Patch

And here is the big news. We have settled on a release for endgame patch. That date is:

January 6th, 2024

With that patch, the game's story will be concluded, and finalized, but we might have some more game contents in the horizon. So please, look forward to that!

Final Words

Once more, we'd like to thank everyone for their infinite patience and goodwill. We will continue to work hard on this game until we deliver it on its best form. That time is approaching, so please, stay with us, friends!

As usual, Let us know in the comments if you'd like to see anything in particular fixed, since we haven't been able to upload a new build due to new contents being developed. We will put your requests in our bugfixes and suggestions backlog.

Thank you and stay safe and sound, everyone. Until next time!

notes.title: Major Game Update: Early Access Build 1.01a
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36818789/c38ae54af88b7e96cdedc3f53663aff47b463701.png

Hello Everyone!

Today we are excited to provide you with a bit of good news! We have worked hard in the past week to finalize, implement, test and update some important language localizations for the game: Simplified/Traditional Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese.

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes for ver. Early Access Build 1.01a: What does this version contain?

The knights in the Haunted Mansion has had their resistances lowered, and are now vulnerable against all elemental attacks.
Fixed the lack of prompt for receiving the Guardian Robe.
Fixed damage popup not appearing for certain bosses.
Fixed not granting the Master of Some achievement. It will now be granted by going in and exiting the shop once the condition has been fulfilled.
Fixed several softlocking issues.
Fixed an issue with max potion not updating properly with the Regalia outfit.
Fixed an issue with the game crashing after going left from the Livra Caverns B save point.
Updated Tatsuko's seafood parade with new fishes, each with different damage value and effects.
Tatsuko's Element Burst has been implemented.
Changed the trail effects for the attacks of Tengu and Ice Fairy.
Localization for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Brazilian Portuguese has now been added to the game.
Updated the graphics for Gastova's Festive Witch costume.

[hr][/hr]
Next Steps
Our next goal is to continue developing the endgame contents of the game. We have most of it figured out. For now, the game stops after beating Aldebaran, but we have a new major content update coming up somewhere between mid to late January, so please, look forward to that one.

That wraps up our update today. Make sure to let us know via the Discussions what you think, we'll be happy to respond whatever questions you guys have!

Stay safe everyone!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36818789/8014c6d2336ac9a8b1d407eed2438ca19bffda01.png

Hello Everyone!

We're very excited to announce that we are going into a public Early Access Release for Gastova: the Witches of Arkana!

Steam Early Access will begin on December 7th, 2022 at 00:00 EST

A few things to note:

 The demo for the game has been taken down shortly as the build is severely outdated. We have massively changed the game for the better as well, so the demo doesn't suffice to represent the game any longer. For the time being, we also have no plans to upload a new demo, as the game will be impacted by Early Access feedback and change constantly.
 Unfortunately, while we tried our best to accomodate the save files of past builds but there's a good chance that all older save files will no longer work with this current build. We recommend starting a new game with the new build to minimize the possibility of issues. We apologize for the inconvenience.
 The game will only be available in English for the time being. We have plans to address this at a later date.

Lastly, for the players who opt to participate in the Early Access, we are going to make the Festive Hat Witch DLC Free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36818789/3a5169b05d63c76e7196d2b21b7549e0dcede466.png

This is a costume for Gastova, and you can access it through her closet in her house. Costumes will be an extra element of the game (though not a requirement in any means to normally beat it), and many will be free within the game itself!

That's it for now. We will have more news and important information to relay at the day of the release.

Stay safe everyone!

notes.title: Release date changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're sorry to inform you that the release date for Gastova: Witches of Arkana has been pushed back several months. It would seem that our original release date was overly optimistic. We need a bit more time to polish the game and finish up the contents we'd like the game to have. As such, we're tentatively going to postpone announcing a fixed date for now. We'll be doing this to avoid the same issues that have plagued us so far. That being said, please rest assured that we'll be doing our best to deliver the game as soon as we can, and be reassured the release will still happen this year. We'll keep you all posted if there are any further changes in the coming days. Sorry again for the inconvenience!

Kickstarter post here, detailing our current progress situation:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gastova/gastova-the-witches-of-arkana/posts/3147266

notes.title: Gastova: The Witches of Arkana Release Date Changes and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36818789/636c5c44f569c1869aed734dad74bf9c481081fe.png

Hi Everyone!

We'd like to briefly discuss changes regarding Gastova: The Witches of Arkana's release date, and where we'll go from here onwards. As it stands, we'll need more time to fully realize this game.

While we understand this may upset those who were looking forward for the game's imminent release, we believe it's important to not rush things and make sure the game will be released in its most fun and stable form. We'd like to thank everyone for your patience and continuous support, we'll do our very best!

The game's new release date will be on April 29th, 2021.

You can find out more about this on our latest Kickstarter campaign update, where we detail a roadmap as well as a sneak peak in progress!

And that’s it from us today, we’ll see you all on our next update!
